question: Which subdomains have effective coverage of 10 or higher?
cypher: MATCH (sd:SubDomain) WHERE sd.effectiveCoverage >= 10.0 RETURN sd.subDomainId, sd.name, sd.effectiveCoverage, sd.effectiveCoverageTier ORDER BY sd.effectiveCoverage DESC;
